title: Lemon Pepper Salmon
description: Flaky salmon fillets with a golden lemon pepper crust, served over a bed of fluffy white rice with blistered cherry tomatoes.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F while you work.
Start the rice in the Instant Pot on about a 12-minute setting, a little before everything else so it's ready at the same time.
Cut the salmon and sprinkle it with lemon juice.
Drizzle with olive oil if using, then season with lemon pepper.
Prep the tomatoes and/or other veggies and sprinkle them with a mix of salt, black pepper, chili powder and garlic powder.
Bake the salmon and veggies for about 20 minutes.
tips: The lemon juice takes away the earthy, dirt-like taste salmon can sometimes have.
